title: Field Phlebotomy Supervisor Northern California
description:
Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.

 

Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patientsâ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability.

 

Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabsâ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone.


About the role: 

We are currently seeking a full-time Field Phlebotomy Supervisor interested in joining a high-growth stage startup. The mandate of the Field Phlebotomy Supervisor is simple but challenging: assist our Operations Manager with the day-to-day operations throughout the market and ensure our patients have the best experience possible.

 

The Field Phlebotomy Supervisor oversees the quality of territories patient operations. You will be responsible for ensuring that every Getlabs experience meets and exceeds the patient's expectations. You will also help train and ensure quality for our team of hourly phlebotomists.  Above all, we are seeking candidates who are self-starters and are resourceful, organized, detail-oriented, communicative, and friendly.

 

This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a one-hour commute of the San Francisco Bay Area. 

 

 

 

 

\n


At Getlabs, you will:
  • Supervise a team of mobile phlebotomists in one or more geographical markets
  • Assess work performance and perform appointment reviews for compliance, quality, and safety on a regular basis; accurately report all findings
  • Administer disciplinary action as appropriate
  • Interview and hire new mobile phlebotomists
  • Effectively and efficiently onboard new hires
  • Complete new hire and annual competency assessments for team
  • Ensure accurate order and patient appointment record-keeping 
  • Administer performance reviewsHandle employee concerns and grievances
  • Review daily/weekly schedules for team and make schedule adjustments as needed; organize, plan, and assign work
  • Plan and manage a budget
  • Assist with day-to-day customer service and manager-level escalations including interactions with patients via inbound calls, outbound calls, emails, and other communication platforms
  • Review and approve team timecards and expenses 


What we are looking for:
  • At least 2 years of management experience in a leadership position is required
  • Phlebotomy certification from an accredited agency is required: American Medical Technologists (AMT), American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT) In-depth knowledge of phlebotomy duties, responsibilities and techniques a plus!
  • Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service
  • Strong communication skills; both written and verbal (Google suite a plus)
  • A disciplined worker who can work independently or in a team environment
  • Reliable transportation and clean driving record
  • Competency with Google applications and willingness to embrace new technology
  • A proven ability to handle ambiguity in the absence of defined systems and processes


We have great benefits to make your life easier so you can focus on what you're best at:
  • Competitive annual salary ranging $95,000-$105,000
  • Valuable stock option plan
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance options
  • Flexible and unlimited vacation
  • A company with a huge vision, a dynamic work environment, and a team of talented, ambitious and fun to work-with colleagues!


\n

The health and safety of our employees and their families is our top priority. Due to the ongoing nature of the COVID-19 pandemic we have decided to require vaccination as a condition of employment for any employee who is in contact with patients.

 

Getlabs is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or other protected classes.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

title: Sales Development Representative German Speaking
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

About the company

Our client is a fast-growing PropTech company revolutionizing the real estate market by bridging the gap between property seekers and managers. Their innovative platform acts as a centralized ecosystem, aggregating listings from all major portals while providing exclusive access to off-market opportunities. By automating the listing and search processes, the team delivers a seamless, data-driven experience that simplifies high-stakes transactions for both individual tenants and professional administrators.

Operating within the dynamic European real estate sector, this scale-up focuses on high-impact automation and intelligent matching technology. The team is dedicated to building a scalable, two-sided marketplace where each participant strengthens the overall network. Joining this ambitious company means working in a collaborative, tech-forward environment focused on solving complex logistical challenges through smart software. Candidates will have the opportunity to drive meaningful innovation in a traditional industry, contributing to a product that provides transparency and efficiency in the modern housing market.

Job Summary

We are looking for a high-energy, resilient Sales Development Representative to be the first point of contact for property management companies across Switzerland and the DACH region. This is a pure "door-opener" role focused on high-volume outbound activity. You won't be closing deals or managing long-term accounts; instead, you will be the engine driving our growth by identifying decision-makers and articulating the value of our AI-driven re-letting solutions. This is an opportunity to work directly with the founders, shape the sales playbook, and play a pivotal role in scaling a high-growth prop-tech startup.

Key Responsibilities
  • Execute 40â50 high-quality outbound dials per day to pre-qualified leads in the property management sector.
  • Pitch decision-makers (Heads of Property Management and C-level executives) to book product demonstrations for the founding team.
  • Manage a high-volume pipeline within Pipedrive, ensuring every contact has a status, next step, and accurate follow-up date.
  • Collaborate with the founders by listening in on booked demos to understand market objections and refine the sales pitch.
  • Verify and approve 10â15 new leads daily from the automated lead generation system to maintain CRM health.
  • Consistently hit targets of approximately 15 booked and completed demos per month.
  • Native or bilingual fluency in German and Swiss German (Dialect is essential for building rapport with our customer base).
  • A "hunter" mindset with a genuine passion for outbound cold calling and the ability to handle rejection with professional persistence.
  • Strong organizational skills and the discipline to manage high-volume activity through a CRM.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to deliver a compelling value proposition in under two minutes.
  • Residency in Switzerland, with the ability to work on-site in Zurich or remotely within the country.

Nice-to-Haves
  • Previous experience in B2B sales or lead generation.
  • Background in the real estate or property management industry.
  • Familiarity with Pipedrive or similar CRM sales stacks.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
About B2Spin
We are B2Spin, and we are dedicated to delivering the best Free-to-Play Social Casino and gaming experiences by creating captivating, engaging, and unique products that are accessible to everyone. We have built a team of talented professionals from all over the globe, who are working to continually improve the experiences of our players. We are not looking to just be part of the industry, but to revolutionize it.

AI-Driven Engineering Culture

We are actively building an AI-driven engineering organization with a clear and deliberate stance: artificial intelligence is a core part of how we build and deliver software â not an experiment, not a trend, and not an optional add-on.

AI is embedded into our engineering workflows, from system design and prototyping to refactoring, testing, and code review. We expect engineers to be fully comfortable working in AI-driven environments and to treat AI as a primary productivity multiplier. Strong engineering judgment, architectural ownership, and accountability remain essentialâAI amplifies our engineers, it doesnât replace responsibility for technical decisions.

What you will be doing:
â¢ Write well-designed, testable, and scalable code that performs flawlessly in production;
â¢ Take part in the full development cycle from sprint planning to release cycles;
â¢ Ensure smooth development and cooperation between dev teams and product owners;
â¢ Build customer-facing consumer web and mobile applications for global audiences;
â¢ Implement third-party integrations including external APIs and analytics;
â¢ Optimize for SEO performance and PageSpeed improvements.

What we are looking for:
â¢ Strong commercial experience in React, TypeScript and Next.js;
â¢ Motivation to grow into cross-platform development (web and mobile).
â¢ End-to-end thinking across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. Willingness to contribute beyond frontend scope when needed.
â¢ Solid expertise with HTML/CSS, including responsive and cross-browser development;
â¢ Experience with third-party integrations (external APIs, analytics);
â¢ Proven track record with SEO optimizations and PageSpeed improvements;
â¢ Strong UI/UX experience with Figma;
â¢ Good English skills in speaking and writing (B2+).

Why you will love it:

High Pace, High Growth, Real Impact â Youâll thrive in our culture of rapid development, continuous learning, and meaningful outcomes. Work remotely with full flexibility, enjoy generous leave policies, and be part of company events that build genuine connections. Every line of code you write directly impacts millions of users worldwide, and youâll see your contributions shape the future of social gaming while advancing your career in a supportive, ego-free environment.

Benefits:

Generous Leave Policy: Take advantage of paid time off, encompassing both vacation and sick leave, to ensure you can recharge and recover when needed. Take your time on bank holidays as well.

Continuously Development: Get an opportunity to join a fast-growing business where the skyâs the limit.

Company Events: Engage in our vibrant company culture through a variety of informal events designed to foster camaraderie and teamwork.

Full Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely from wherever you feel most productive.

title: Accounting and Implementation Manager
description:

Discover a top-rated culture, vast growth opportunities and your next big career move with Aprio.


Aprio is seeking an Aprio is seeking an Accounting and Implementation Manager  to lead restaurant, franchise, and hospitality platform implementations, re-implementations, and optimization initiatives that connect accounting, operations, and technology. In this role, you will partner with clients and our accounting team to translate complex accounting and operational needs into practical configurations, integrations, workflows, controls, reporting structures, and training across platforms including Restaurant365 (R365), QuickBooks Online (QBO), Sage Intacct, and other industry-specific tools. You will serve as a trusted technology resource across the practice â driving implementation quality, enabling team capability, and building a repeatable, scalable delivery model. This is a high-impact opportunity for a systems-minded professional who brings both accounting fluency and a practical approach to helping people get the most from their technology.

\n


What You'll Gain/ Impact
  • Clients will have platform environments that support reliable accounting, disciplined operations, strong controls, and sustainable growth
  • Our accounting team will have the tools, training, documentation, and responsive support needed to serve clients efficiently across multiple platforms
  • Implementations will move forward with clear ownership, clean master data, disciplined testing, timely decisions, and fewer surprises
  • Your improvements will reduce manual work, strengthen operating data, and build a repeatable, high-value delivery capability across the practice
 


Key Responsibilities

Platform Implementation & Re-Implementation

  • Lead implementations and re-implementations across restaurant, franchise, and hospitality platforms â including R365, QBO, Sage Intacct, and other industry-specific tools â from discovery and design through configuration, testing, cutover, and stabilization
  • Partner with clients and our accounting team to translate accounting and operational needs into practical plans, system designs, and success criteria
  • Configure and validate entities, locations, calendars, chart of accounts, reporting, user roles, approvals, banking, daily sales, AP, payroll, and inventory workflows
  • Guide data readiness, testing, decisions, and go-live activities while helping the accounting team resolve issues that affect service delivery, close, and reporting

Client Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Own accounting and financial reporting for assigned clients, including agreed-upon deliverables, deadlines, responsibilities, and scope.
  • Lead month-end and year-end close, using technology and automation where appropriate to improve consistency, identify exceptions, and accelerate routine work.
  • Prepare and review complete, accurate, and well-supported workpapers that clearly document account activity, reconciliations, conclusions, and the audit trail supporting financial reporting.

Restaurant Operations Configuration

  • Build and govern inventory items, categories, locations, count practices, costing methods, and location availability
  • Review and map vendor items; configure units of measure, pack sizes, conversions, and yields to support accurate purchasing, invoicing, and inventory valuation
  • Build recipes, sub-recipes, menu items, and theoretical costs; map POS and PMIX data to recipes and resolve exceptions affecting usage and margin reporting
  • Configure labor scheduling, job codes, forecasting inputs, and targets; establish best-practice routines for counts, waste, transfers, receiving, recipe maintenance, and exception review

Platform Optimization & Process Design

  • Evaluate platform environments â including R365, QBO, Sage Intacct, and other tools â alongside accounting and operations teams to identify configuration gaps, workarounds, control weaknesses, and improvement opportunities
  • Simplify and standardize workflows, templates, naming conventions, approvals, dashboards, and recurring processes across entities and locations
  • Prioritize improvements based on impact, effort, risk, and readiness, then help teams adopt sustainable platform governance

Integrations, Data & Reporting

  • Coordinate POS, banking, invoice capture, payments, payroll, sales, inventory, and other integrations across applicable platforms
  • Lead mapping, migration, validation, exception resolution, and testing so the accounting team can rely on complete, accurate data
  • Build reporting structures, dashboards, and role-based access that help accounting teams deliver timely, decision-ready information to clients

Training, Adoption & Knowledge Enablement

  • Develop and deliver role-based training for our accounting team, client administrators, and accounting, AP, banking, sales, inventory, purchasing, recipe, labor, payroll, and close users across applicable platforms
  • Coach users on best practices for counts, item and unit-of-measure governance, recipes, POS/PMIX exceptions, labor scheduling, and data-quality reviews
  • Create clear documentation, job aids, workflows, controls, governance standards, and troubleshooting guidance the accounting team can use in daily client service
  • Provide post-go-live support, address recurring pain points, and recommend targeted training or system improvements
 


Candidate Qualifications

Required:

  • Experience supporting restaurant, franchise, hospitality, multi-entity, or multi-location businesses
  • Background in outsourced accounting, CAS, public accounting, or another multi-client professional-services environment
  • Experience improving accounting, reporting, analytics, or client-service workflows through technology or automation 
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, Hospitality Management, Project Management, or a related field
  • Five or more years of ERP implementation, accounting technology, restaurant systems or operations, systems consulting, or related professional-services experience
  • Hands-on experience with Restaurant365 (R365), QuickBooks Online (QBO), Sage Intacct, or comparable restaurant, franchise, or hospitality platform implementation, administration, optimization, or support
  • Working knowledge of close, reporting, banking, daily sales, AP, inventory, purchasing, item mapping, units of measure, recipes, POS/PMIX, payroll, labor scheduling, and controls
  • Strong client-facing project leadership, facilitation, documentation, problem-solving, change-management, and communication skills

Preferred:

  • R365 certification, Sage Intacct certification, or advanced experience across accounting and operations modules
  • Restaurant, franchise, hospitality, multi-entity, or multi-location experience, including POS/PMIX, inventory, recipe costing, labor, AP, payroll, banking, and reporting tools
  • Experience across multiple restaurant, franchise, or hospitality platforms such as QBO, Sage Intacct, or other industry-specific ERP and accounting solutions
  • Experience in outsourced accounting, CAS, ERP consulting, restaurant technology, culinary systems, or scalable implementation and governance design
 


\n

Why work for Aprio:

Whether you are just starting out, looking to advance into management or searching for your next leadership role, Aprio offers an opportunity to grow with a future-focused, innovative firm.

 

 

Perks/Benefits we offer for full-time team members:

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance on the first day of employment

- Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care Account

- 401k with Profit Sharing

- 9+ holidays and discretionary time off structure

- Parental Leave â coverage for both primary and secondary caregivers

- Tuition Assistance Program and CPA support program with cash incentive upon completion

- Discretionary incentive compensation based on firm, group and individual performance

- Incentive compensation related to origination of new client sales

- Top rated wellness program

- Flexible working environment including remote and hybrid options

 

 

Whatâs in it for you:

- Working with an industry leader: Be part of a high-growth firm that is passionate for whatâs next.

- An awesome culture: Thirty-one fundamental behaviors guide our culture every day ensuring we always deliver an exceptional team-member and client experience.  We call it the Aprio Way.  This shared mindset creates lasting relationships between team members and with clients.

- A great team: Work with a high-energy, passionate, caring and ambitious team of professionals in a collaborative culture.

- Entrepreneurship: Have the freedom to innovate and bring your ideas to help us grow to become the CPA firm of choice nationally.

- Growth opportunities: Grow professionally in an environment that fosters continuous learning and advancement.

- Competitive compensation: You will be rewarded with competitive compensation, industry-leading benefits and a flexible work environment to enjoy work/life balance.

 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Aprio is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex; pregnancy; sexual orientation; gender identity and/or expression; age; disability; genetic information, citizenship status; military service obligations or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Travel Support Specialist
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking dependable and customer-focused individuals to join our team as a Travel Support Specialist. This remote role focuses on assisting clients with travel-related inquiries, supporting reservation coordination, and ensuring a smooth and positive customer experience throughout the booking process.

This is an entry-level opportunity within the travel industry. No prior travel experience is required. Structured onboarding and training are provided.

\n


Key Responsibilities
  • Respond to client inquiries regarding travel options, reservations, and itinerary details
  • Assist with coordinating and confirming bookings for hotels, cruises, and vacation packages
  • Review travel information for accuracy, including dates, traveler details, and accommodations
  • Provide timely updates and clear communication before and after travel
  • Maintain organized records of client interactions and reservations
  • Deliver professional and responsive customer support


Qualifications
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Customer-focused mindset with attention to detail
  • Comfortable using online systems and digital platforms
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Previous customer service, hospitality, or administrative experience is helpful but not required


\n
$35,000 - $65,000 a year
\n

What We Offer

  • Structured onboarding and guided training
  • Access to booking tools and travel supplier resources
  • Ongoing professional development opportunities
  • Flexible remote work environment
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture

Ideal Candidate

This role is well suited for individuals seeking remote customer service opportunities, career changers exploring the travel industry, or professionals with service-oriented backgrounds.

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the clientâs team and work as part of it.

  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the teamâs hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

Who weâre looking for

DevOps with Python/Bash:

  • 4+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • At least 3 years of experience with Python/Golang/Bash
  • 3+ years of experience with AWS/GCP/Microsoft Azure/Azure DevOps/Kubernetes is required
  • Experience in at least 2 commercial projects using Terraform and SQL is required

DevOps or Site Reliability Engineer with Linux:

  • 4+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • At least 3 years of experience with Linux
  • At least 3 years of experience using Networking is required

DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer/Platform Engineer with Python/Golang:

  • 4+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer

Salary : PHP 90,000 - PHP 110,000 /month

Working Hours & Conditions: Observing AU business hours

Holidays : Observing AU holidays

ROLE OVERVIEW:

Our client is an end-to-end B2B SaaS platform delivering specialized workforce management software designed for operational precision across scheduling, compliance, time tracking, invoicing, and payroll. Operating in a high-volume, multi-entity environment undergoing rapid international expansion and strategic acquisitions, the organization is bringing its core finance operations fully in-house to support scalable long-term growth. Working closely with executive leadership, this critical role goes beyond traditional accounting to take complete ownership of financial consolidations, month-end close optimization, SaaS performance metrics, and commercial analysis. We are seeking a proactive leader with a Financial Controller mindset who can independently challenge assumptions, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and bring clear financial visibility to strategic executive decisions.Â 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Financial Close, Reporting & Multi-Entity Consolidation:
    • Take end-to-end ownership of the month-end close cycle, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and consolidated financial reporting.
    • Lead the strategic transition of financial close and reporting activities from external advisers to the internal finance function.
    • Audit and streamline close workflows to significantly reduce month-end closing timelines from 2â3 weeks.
    • Prepare accurate, consolidated profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports across multiple domestic and international entities while maintaining audit-ready documentation.
  • Management Accounting & Commercial Analysis:
    • Deliver monthly management accounts supported by deep, commercially relevant commentary on business performance and profitability drivers.
    • Perform budget-versus-actual and month-on-month variance analyses, actively investigating root causes rather than merely reporting numbers.
    • Develop, maintain, and refine annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and multi-entity cash flow projections.
    • Partner with executive leadership to evaluate operational margins, identify financial risks, and translate complex financial data into actionable growth strategies.
  • SaaS Performance Metrics & Revenue Recognition:
    • Track, analyze, and report on key SaaS metrics, including MRR, ARR, churn, customer retention, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and customer lifetime value (LTV).
    • Reconcile complex subscription, recurring billing, and usage data with core management accounts in full alignment with revenue recognition principles.
  • Acquisitions & Process Transformation:
    • Support post-acquisition financial integrations, harmonizing accounting policies, chart of accounts, and financial frameworks across acquired businesses.

    • Coach and uplift existing bookkeeping and operational finance team members, establishing clear procedures, responsibilities, and reporting deadlines.

  • Professional qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent.
  • Direct reporting experience to a CFO, Finance Director, or senior executive.
  • Exposure to Australian accounting standards, tax compliance, and business frameworks.

title: Accounting & Finance Manager
description:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.Â 

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

  • High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients
  • Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better
  • Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential
  • High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected
  • Mission-driven teamwork: weâre passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what itâs like to work with us here:Â  politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.Â 

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firmâs financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.Â 

This role serves as the firmâs first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firmâs systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.Â 

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firmâs needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations ManagementÂ 

  • Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly.
  • Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.Â Â 
  • Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.Â Â 
  • Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.Â Â 
  • Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.Â Â 
  • Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time.

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and ForecastingÂ 

  • Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time.
  • Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.Â Â 
  • Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.Â Â 
  • Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed.
  • Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.Â Â 
  • Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.Â Â 
  • Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.Â Â 
  • Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.Â Â 

Billing, Collections, and Accounts ReceivableÂ 

  • Own and continuously improve the firmâs billing and collections process.Â Â 
  • Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.Â Â 
  • Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.Â Â 
  • Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.Â Â 
  • Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.Â Â 
  • Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.Â Â 
  • Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firmâs financial interests.Â Â 
  • Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.Â 
  • Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances.
  • Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.Â Â 

Trust Accounting and ComplianceÂ 

  • Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.Â Â 
  • Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.Â Â 
  • Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.Â Â 
  • Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.Â Â 
  • Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.Â Â 
  • Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.Â Â 

Internal Controls and Risk ManagementÂ 

  • Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.Â Â 
  • Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.Â Â 
  • Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.Â Â 
  • Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.Â Â 
  • Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.Â Â 
  • Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.Â Â 

Finance Team and Vendor OversightÂ 

  • Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.Â Â 
  • Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.Â Â 
  • Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.Â 
  • Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.Â Â 
  • Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.Â Â 
  • Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.Â Â 
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows.
  • Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows.
  • Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.Â 
  • Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.Â Â 

Financial Analysis and Business SupportÂ 

  • Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.Â Â 
  • Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.Â Â 
  • Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.Â Â 
  • Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.Â Â 
  • Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.Â Â 
  • Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.Â 
Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required QualificationsÂ 

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.Â Â 
  • Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.Â Â 
  • Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.Â Â 
  • Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.Â Â 
  • Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools.
  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems.
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required.
  • Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.Â Â 
  • Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.Â Â 
  • Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.Â Â 
  • High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.Â Â 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment.

Â Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.Â Â 
  • 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.Â Â 
  • Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred.
  • Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.Â Â 
  • Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.Â Â 
  • Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.Â Â 
  • Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial performance reports.Â Â 
  • Experience supervising bookkeepers, billing specialists, payroll providers, or outsourced accounting vendors.Â Â 
  • Advanced experience with complex unstructured data models and analysis, pricing analysis, SKU profitability, labor utilization, realization, collection rate analysis, and cost-of-acquisition reporting.Â Â 
  • Experience supporting strategic planning, cash flow planning, debt repayment planning, and owner distribution planning.Â 
What We Offer

This position offers a monthly salary range of USD 3,000 - 3,500 gross, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

â Week between Christmas and New Year's â office closed, fully paid

â Your country's national public holidays off (paid) - your paid national holidays follow your own country's calendar

â Three weeks of paid vacation annually

â Comprehensive training program â we invest in bringing you up to speed on our systems, content processes, and best practices

â Mentorship and collaboration â learn from experienced team members and contribute your expertise

â Career advancement paths â we promote from within and create opportunities

â Work from anywhere â this position is open to candidates based in Argentina.

â Equipment support â stipend or provided equipment to set up your home office, available after 4 months on the job

How to Apply

To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter, both of which must be in English.

Your application won't be considered without a cover letter. Your cover letter should explain why you're uniquely qualified for this particular position, and why you would be a great fit for our law firm. Generic, copy/paste cover letters will be discarded.

Upload your cover letter and resume, in PDF format, through the software program where you're viewing this announcement.

Please do not call or email us about this opening.

title: Accounting Operations
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Weâre dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Role Overview

You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.

You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.

Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.

  • Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.

  • Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.

  • Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.

  • Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.

  • Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;

  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus

  • Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches.

  • Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • Hands-on, can-do attitude, willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution.

  • Proven change agent with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations.

  • Strong communicator and collaborator who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.


Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!


Your Team and Role

Working on the Backend Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. Using Perl (Version 5), Go, and Node.js, youâll write pragmatic, performant, testable code that works consistently, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Implementing AI-assisted answers and integrating them into our Search product while maintaining our privacy-first approach

  • Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users

  • Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo.


About You

  • 7+ years of professional experience, primarily focused on backend systems that power consumer-facing products

  • Product acumen to reason about technical tradeoffs in terms of user impact

  • Familiarity with AI agent tooling: evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering

  • A fundamental understanding of complex data structures and algorithms â you can develop and apply new solutions and confidently navigate and improve existing code.

  • Data-driven analytical skills for decision-making, stakeholder alignment, and experiment-oriented delivery

  • Solid project management abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication to validate and articulate decisions

  • Previous experience leading and mentoring experienced engineers, supporting their career goals, and unlocking their potential.


Compensation

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

  • United States: $190,500 USD annually

  • United Kingdom: Â£134,600 GBP annually

  • Canada: C$253,500 CAD annually

  • Europe/Rest of World: â¬157,350 EUR annually

In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.


Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.


Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.


Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.



Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any typeÂ on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.


We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.


Please note that:

  • Youâll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.


Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicantsâ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

title: Clinical Data Manager
description:
General Summary
The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME).

We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.


Specific Duties and Responsibilities
â¢Independently lead and/or perform all data management activities within an assigned study (e.g., study startup, study conduct, study closeout, and reporting). *
â¢Serve as the data management SME on multidisciplinary project teams providing specific expertise on timeline development, identification of data management deliverables and resource requirements. *
â¢Participate in the creation, review, and maintenance of project timelines and monitor progress of data management activities. *
â¢Provide oversight for Data Management CRO and other vendors to ensure compliance with the protocol, external/internal standards, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), applicable regulatory guidelines, SOPs, and other relevant guidelines.
â¢Ensure Data Management documentation is filed/archived according to applicable Penumbra and regulatory requirements. *
â¢Interact with data management, biostatistics, Clinical Affairs and Medical Affairs team to ensure integrity and quality of data. *
â¢Contribute ideas to the development of the department, identifying areas for improvement (e.g., SOPs, processes)
â¢Participates in audits and inspections. *
â¢Attend Investigator Meetings when requested to provide training on CRF data completion.
â¢Responsible for creation of training materials and training of the CRAs to ensure consistency of data entry at the sites. *
â¢Provide DM departmental training and to other teams, as needed.
â¢Utilizes reports to track study progress and ensure timeliness and quality expectations are met.
â¢Adhere to the Companyâs Quality Management System (QMS) as well as domestic and global quality system regulations, standards, and procedures. *
â¢Understand relevant security, privacy and compliance principles and adhere to the regulations, standards, and procedures that are applicable to the Company. *
â¢Ensure other members of the department follow the QMS, regulations, standards, and procedures. *
â¢Perform other work-related duties as assigned.
*Indicates an essential function of the role


Required Qualifications
Minimum education and experience
â¢Bachelor's degree with 5+ years in a medical device, pharmaceutical company, or similar environment (e.g., CRO); or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred qualifications
â¢Masterâs degree with 3+ years of clinical research, pharmaceutical company preferred
â¢Thorough knowledge of effective clinical data management practices; CCDM certified professional a plus
â¢Must have strong experience with systems used for electronic capture of clinical trial data (e.g., iMedidata Rave, InForm, eClinicalOS, RedCap)
â¢This position must have experience working on regulatory trials within the medical device and/or pharmaceutical industry
â¢Position requires technical, organizational, analytical, and strong communication skills
â¢Knowledge of regulatory guidelines pertaining to data quality and data management
â¢Proven experience and in-depth understanding of all aspects of Data Management
â¢Ability to effectively manage change and multiple priorities
â¢Ability to operate independently and achieve results; ability to effectively deal with employees and business contacts and conveys a positive service-oriented attitude
â¢Knowledge of continuous improvement, project management, change management, and risk management
â¢Medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated industry experience required
â¢Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

 

Working Conditions
â¢General office environment
â¢Willingness and ability to work on site.
â¢May have business travel from 0% - 5% to conferences and/or other Penumbra affiliated facilities.
â¢Potential exposure to blood-borne pathogens
â¢Requires some lifting and moving of up to 25 pounds
â¢Must be able to move between buildings and floors.
â¢Must be able to remain stationary and use a computer or other standard office equipment, such as a printer or copy machine, for an extensive period of time each day.
â¢Must be able to read, prepare emails, and produce documents and spreadsheets.
â¢Must be able to move within the office and access file cabinets or supplies, as needed.
â¢Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis. Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis.

 

Base Pay Range Per Hour: $50.00 - $80.00
Individual compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

\n


\n

What We Offer

â¢ A collaborative teamwork environment where learning is constant, and performance is rewarded.

â¢ The opportunity to be part of the team that is revolutionizing the treatment of some of the world's most devastating diseases.

â¢ A generous benefits package for eligible employees that includes medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, short and long-term disability insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid parental leave, eleven paid company holidays per year, a minimum of fifteen days of accrued vacation per year, which increases with tenure, and paid sick time in compliance with applicable law(s).

 

Penumbra, Inc., headquartered in Alameda, California, is a global healthcare company focused on innovative therapies. Penumbra designs, develops, manufactures, and markets novel products and has a broad portfolio that addresses challenging medical conditions in markets with significant unmet need. Penumbra sells its products to hospitals and healthcare providers primarily through its direct sales organization in the United States, most of Europe, Canada, and Australia, and through distributors in select international markets. The Penumbra logo is a trademark of Penumbra, Inc.

 

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

 

If you reside in the State of California, please also refer to Penumbra's Privacy Notice for California Residents.

 

For additional information on Penumbraâs commitment to being an equal opportunity employer, please see Penumbra's AAP Policy Statement.

description:

Enterprise Risk | Compliance | Governance | Financial & Operational Risk

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for reporting cycles, audits, and incident response)

About the Role

At Pavago, weâre hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Risk Analyst / Risk Manager to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate financial, operational, compliance, and enterprise risks across the organization.

This is a high-impact role where youâll help safeguard the business by developing risk frameworks, analyzing emerging threats, strengthening internal controls, and delivering actionable insights that support strategic decision-making.

Youâll work closely with Finance, Operations, Compliance, Legal, IT, and Executive Leadership to ensure the organization remains compliant, resilient, and prepared for evolving business risks.

If youâre analytical, detail-oriented, and enjoy translating complex risk data into practical business recommendations, this role is built for you.

What Youâll OwnEnterprise Risk Assessment
  • Conduct enterprise-wide risk assessments across:
    • Financial risk
    • Operational risk
    • Compliance risk
    • Market risk
    • Cybersecurity risk
  • Maintain and update:
    • Risk registers
    • Control matrices
    • Risk assessments
    • Remediation trackers
  • Identify emerging risks and prioritize mitigation activities.
  • Partner with business leaders to strengthen proactive risk management practices.

Risk Modeling & Analytics
  • Build and maintain quantitative risk models using:
    • SQL
    • Excel
    • Python
    • R
    • SAS
  • Perform:
    • Stress testing
    • Scenario analysis
    • Sensitivity analysis
    • Regression analysis
    • Monte Carlo simulations
    • Value at Risk (VaR) modeling
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and key risk indicators (KRIs).
  • Deliver data-driven recommendations to leadership.

Compliance & Regulatory Oversight
  • Support compliance with applicable frameworks such as:
    • SOX
    • Basel III
    • Dodd-Frank
    • GDPR
    • HIPAA
    • PCI-DSS
    • Industry-specific regulations
  • Prepare quarterly and annual compliance reports.
  • Support internal and external audits.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence.
  • Track remediation activities and regulatory deadlines.

Internal Controls & Governance
  • Test and evaluate internal controls.
  • Monitor incidents, exceptions, and risk events through Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms.
  • Support governance committees with reporting and documentation.
  • Partner with IT and Security teams on:
    • Cyber risk
    • Vendor risk
    • Operational resilience
  • Recommend improvements to governance processes and internal controls.

Reporting & Executive Communication
  • Build dashboards and reports using:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Excel
  • Present risk trends and mitigation recommendations to leadership.
  • Translate technical risk findings into clear business insights.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for executive reporting and audit purposes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
    • Finance
    • Operations
    • Compliance
    • Legal
    • IT & Security
    • Executive Leadership
  • Embed risk awareness into business processes.
  • Support continuous improvement of enterprise risk management frameworks.

RequirementsMust-Have QualificationsExperience
  • 3+ years of experience in:
    • Risk Management
    • Enterprise Risk
    • Compliance
    • Audit
    • Governance
  • Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments.
Core Skills
  • Strong proficiency in:
    • SQL
    • Microsoft Excel
    • Data analysis
  • Experience using Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms such as:
    • Archer
    • ServiceNow
    • LogicManager
    • Or similar solutions
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
    • Internal controls
    • Regulatory compliance
  • Experience creating executive dashboards and risk reports.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have
  • Professional certifications such as:
    • FRM
    • CFA
    • CPA
    • CCEP
  • Experience with:
    • VaR
    • Monte Carlo simulations
    • Stress testing
  • Background in:
    • Financial Services
    • Healthcare
    • SaaS
    • Enterprise Technology
  • Experience supporting board reporting or executive governance committees.
  • Knowledge of:
    • Cyber risk
    • Vendor risk
    • Operational resilience
  • Experience using:
    • Tableau
    • Power BI
    • Looker

What Makes You a Strong Fit
  • Strong analytical and quantitative mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Able to simplify complex risk concepts for business stakeholders.
  • Proactive in identifying issues before they become significant risks.
  • Strong balance of technical expertise and business judgment.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Tools & Technologies
  • SQL
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Python
  • R
  • SAS
  • Power BI
  • Tableau
  • Looker
  • Archer
  • ServiceNow
  • LogicManager
  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) platforms

What a Typical Day Looks Like
  • Review dashboards for emerging operational, financial, or compliance risks.
  • Run quantitative risk analyses and stress tests.
  • Update risk registers and remediation trackers.
  • Test internal controls and validate governance processes.
  • Prepare executive reports and compliance documentation.
  • Collaborate with business teams to strengthen risk mitigation strategies.
  • Track remediation progress and regulatory deadlines.

In short: You serve as the organizationâs early-warning systemâidentifying, assessing, and mitigating risks before they impact the business.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)
  • Timely and accurate risk reporting.
  • Internal controls tested and validated on schedule.
  • Early identification and mitigation of business risks.
  • Zero missed regulatory or audit deadlines.
  • High-quality executive reporting and dashboards.
  • Positive audit outcomes and leadership confidence.

Why Join Us?
  • Make a direct impact on enterprise risk strategy.
  • Work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Influence governance, compliance, and operational resilience.
  • Build scalable risk management frameworks.
  • Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Clear career progression into:
    • Senior Risk Manager
    • Enterprise Risk Lead
    • Director of Risk & Compliance
    • Chief Risk Officer (CRO)

Interview Process
  • Application Review
  • Spark Hire Intro Video (3â5 minutes)
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Practical Assessment (Risk Analysis & Recommendations)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

    • What Happens After You Apply

    Right after you apply, youâll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever itâs convenient for you.

    Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, youâll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

    Donât overthink itâyou can record your video as many times as youâd like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

    Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

    Apply Now

    If youâre a Risk Analyst or Risk Manager who enjoys identifying business risks, strengthening governance, improving compliance, and helping organizations make informed decisions, weâd love to hear from you. Apply today and play a key role in protecting and strengthening a growing business.
